arabic text: SHABBIR KO SAJDAY MAIN ZIBAH KISNAY KIYA HAI
SHABBIR KO SAJDAY MAIN ZIBAH KISNAY KIYA HAI
english translation text: WHO HAS SLAINED SHABBIR IN SAJDAH?

arabic text: GHAAR FATIMA ZAHRA KA TABAH KISNAY KIYA HAI\nMAZLOOM KAY MATAM SAY HUMAY ROKNAY WALON
english translation text: TRYING TO STOP US MOURNING FOR THE OPRESSED IMAM,\nWHO HAS DESTROYED AND PILLAGED THE HOUSE OF ZAHRA

arabic text:
KHAIMAY BHI JAALAHAY TOH RIDAYEN BHI UTHARI
SYEDANIYA SAAR NANGAY KHARI ROTI THI SAARI
HINDU THAY YAHUDI THAY ISAYI YA KOYI AUR
ITNA TO BATA DO YEH GUNAH KISNAY KIYA HAI
english translation text:
TENTS WERE BURNT AND VEILS WERE SNATCHED,
DAUGHTERS OF PROPHET CRYING FOR THEIR HIJABS,
WERE THEY HINDUS, JEWS, CHRISTIANS OR SOMEONE ELSE?
DO TELL US WHO PERPETRATED THESE ATROCITIES?

arabic text:
BAYSHEER KAY HALQOOM PE JAB TEER LAGA THA
AUR PYAAS SE MASOOM KA HAYE KHUSKH GALA THA
ASGHAR NAY ZUBAAN HONTON PAY JAB PERI THI LOGO
TAB KHOON SE TAR KHUSKH GALA KISNAY KIYA HAI
english translation text:
WHEN THE THIRSTY BABY GOT THE ARROW IN HIS NECK,
AND HE WAS DISTRAUGHT WITH SEVERE THIRST,
WHEN ASGAR PUT HIS TOUNGE ON HIS PARCHED LIPS,
WHO QUENCHED HIS THIRST WITH A BLOODY ARROW?

arabic text:
ZANJEERO MAY JAKRAH HUWA SAJAAD MUHARI
AUR SHIMR KAY ZULMO SE DARI BIBIYAN SAARI
JIS BIBI KA SURAJ BHI HAYA KARTA THA CHUP KAR
USS BIBI KAY SAR KO BAYRIDA KISNAY KIYA HAI
english translation text:
BOUND WITH CHAINS SAJJAD IS THE CARAVAN LEADER,
AND ALL THE LADIES ARE FRIGHTENED BY THE CRUELTY OF SHIMR,
THE LADY WHOSE HIJAB WAS RESPECTED BY THE SUN,
WHO SNATCHED AWAY THE VEIL OF ZAINAB?

arabic text:
BARCHHI NAY JO CHEERA ALI AKBAR KAY JIGAR KO
HAYE KAISAY UTHAYA MERAY MOLA NAY PISAR KO
LAILA KA PISAR LAGTA THA TASVEER NABI KI
SARKAR-E-RISALAAT KA HAYA KISNAY KIYA HAI
english translation text:
THE SPEAR TORE THROUGH THE HEART OF ALI AKBAR,
O’ HOW COULD MY MOLA LIFT HIS YOUTHFUL SON,
LAILA’S SON WAS THE REPLICA OF THE PROPHET,
WHO COMMITTED THESE CRIMES ON ALI AKBAR?

arabic text:
APNO KAY BHI MAIYAT PAY NAH TUM ASHKH BAHAO
NA PURSA-AY SHABBIR PEH NAH PEHRAY LAGAO
BAY GORO KAFAN RUN MAY RAHA SHAH KA LASHA
DAFNA NAY KA TAB FARZ-E-ADA KISNAY KIYA HAI
english translation text:
IF YOU DON’T SHED TEARS FOR YOUR OWN DEAD,
DON’T STOP US FROM MOURNING AND CRYING FOR SHABBIR,
THE BODY OF SHABBIR IS WITHOUT A SHROUD,
WHO PERFORMED THE RITES OF BURIAL FOR THESE MARTYRS?

arabic text:
ABBAS-E-WAFADAAR KA PARCHAM HAI NISHANI
YAAD AAYI ISAY DEKH KE KARBAL KI KAHANI
JO HAATH TEH ZAHRA KI DUAWON KAH NATEEJA
UN HAATHON KO SHAAHNO SEH JUDA KISNAY KIYA HAI
english translation text:
LOYAL ABBAS’S FLAG IS A SIGN FOR US,
WE WILL RECALL KARBALA EVERYTIME WE SEE IT,
THOSE ARMS WERE THE ANSWER TO ZAHRA’S PRAYERS,
WHO SEVERED THOSE ARMS FROM THE SHOULDERS?

arabic text:
AKHTAR KO YEH EK MASLA SABHI MULLA BATA AY
KIS JURM MAY LOOTI GAYI KARBAL MAY RIDAAEN
DARBAAR MAY KHUTBA JO PARHA BINTAY ALI NAY
AZAANO SE PHIR SHOWR BAPA KISNAY KIYA HAI
english translation text:
PLEASE TELL AKHTHAR (POET) ALL THE MULLAS,
WHY THE VEILS WERE SNATCHED IN KARBALA?
AS ZAINAB SPOKE IN COURT OF THE TYRANT,
WHO TRIED TO DROWN HER VOICE BY RECITING ADHAAN?
